description: Adjusted Rand Index between Leiden clusters, one per cell type, and the cell-type labels; about 0 = random, 1 = identical; higher = better.
Normalized Mutual Information between Leiden clusters, one per cell type, and the cell-type labels; 0-1; higher = better.
Average silhouette width of the Leiden clusters (one per cell type) on the embedding, rescaled to 0-1; higher = better.

Isolated-label silhouette: the silhouette of each cell (distance to the nearest other Leiden cluster), averaged per cluster and then over clusters. Every cluster is treated as an isolated label (scib's default counts only labels found in few batches); 0-1; higher = better.

Isolated-label F1: for each cell type, the best F1 of one Leiden cluster (one per cell type), averaged over cell types. Every cell type is treated as an isolated label (scib's default counts only types found in few batches); 0-1; higher = better.
Cell-type LISI: how much each cell's neighbours share its cell type on the embedding; the median over cells, scaled to 0-1; higher = better.
Batch silhouette: 1 minus the absolute batch silhouette within each cell type, averaged over cell types; 0-1; higher = better.
Batch ARI: 1 minus the absolute Adjusted Rand Index between Leiden clusters, one per batch, and the batches; 0-1; higher = better.
Batch NMI: 1 minus the Normalized Mutual Information between Leiden clusters, one per batch, and the batches; 0-1; higher = better.
Graph connectivity: for each cell type, the share of its cells in the largest connected part of its neighbour graph, averaged over cell types; 0-1; higher = better.
Integration LISI: how many batches appear among each cell's neighbours on the embedding; the median over cells, scaled to 0-1; higher = better.
k-nearest-neighbour batch effect test: 1 minus the rate at which a test rejects that each neighbourhood has the overall batch mix, averaged over cell types; 0-1; higher = better.
Overall classification accuracy: the fraction of query cells predicted correctly; 0-1; higher = better.
Average classification accuracy: the fraction of each cell type predicted correctly, averaged over cell types; 0-1; higher = better.
Specificity, averaged over cell types; 0-1; higher = better.
Sensitivity, averaged over cell types; 0-1; higher = better.
F1-score, averaged over cell types; 0-1; higher = better.
